notes: WINDFOR is NESO's national wind generation forecast for transmission-connected wind (Power Park Modules), hourly, published several times a day.
FUELHH fuelType=WIND is the measured half-hourly average MW of transmission-metered wind. Embedded (distribution-connected) wind is not included in either dataset.
Actual generation includes the effect of curtailment instructed by the system operator, which the forecast does not model; part of any forecast-minus-actual gap is operational.
